How Your Support Makes a Difference By fundraising for Right To Play, you’re contributing to a global movement that’s using play to protect, educate, and empower children to rise above adversity. In the last year, we reached 1.52 million children and youth in 15 countries, including programs in 75 Indigenous communities in Canada.Right To Play is the only NGO that uses a play-based approach to help children overcome the challenges they face. Through partnerships with governments, educators, coaches, families, and communities, we help children build the skills they need to shape a better future for themselves and the world. The support of our donors and fundraisers plays an integral role in building the capacity for our programs and reaching more children with the transformative power of play.
